observation: Fresh main validates receipt structure/hash/binding on durable read, but does not enforce the receipt presence pattern already produced by the existing state machine: STAGED has no receipts, APPLIED has applyReceipt only, ROLLED_BACK has both. Durable documents can therefore advertise an impossible status/receipt combination while remaining individually well-shaped.
changes: Add a shared durable receipt-lifecycle verifier derived only from the existing stage/apply/rollback writer transitions.
Reject impossible status/receipt combinations before ordinary readers consume them.
Add focused real-store lifecycle regressions without introducing new states, recovery policy, receipt format or trust architecture.

verification.bounded_lifecycle_replay: 8/8 PASS for the exact three valid and five invalid status/receipt combinations.
verification.regression_test_added: tests/changeset-receipt-lifecycle.test.mjs covers invalid durable combinations plus the normal STAGED -> APPLIED -> ROLLED_BACK lifecycle.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remains transiently unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted/full-suite success is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle enforces only lifecycle coherence already implied by existing writers. Deeper rollback-receipt semantic binding, independent provenance/authentication and broader temporal ordering remain separate boundaries.
